mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_dead_letter (id, `type`, payload, biz_key, `status`, attempts, last_error, next_retry_at_ms, created_at_ms, finished_at_ms) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{payload}, #{bizKey}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{lastError}, #{nextRetryAtMs}, #{createdAtMs}, #{finishedAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `status` = VALUES(`status`), attempts = VALUES(attempts), last_error = VALUES(last_error), next_retry_at_ms = VALUES(next_retry_at_ms), finished_at_ms = VALUES(finished_at_ms)
